description: Configuration for XGIC Payload setup via `xgic payload setup`. projectName is identity; projectDir is the filesystem path (producer default app/).

projectName.description: Payload/npm project identity (Compose-safe characters). Not necessarily the directory path — see projectDir.
projectName.title: Projectname

projectDir.description: Relative directory for the generated Payload app. Producers should use a stable path such as 'app' (gitignored). Use '.' only for pure application repositories (app-root layout).
projectDir.title: Projectdir

layout.description: auto = detect producer vs app repo; app-root = workspace root; subdir = use projectDir (default app for producers).
layout.title: Layout

template.description: Which official Payload starter template to scaffold

example.description: Optional: Use a specific Payload example instead of a template
example.title: Example

agent.description: Coding agent skill to install inside the generated project. Use 'none' (recommended) when running inside a dev container or CI to avoid installing Claude Code / Cursor / Codex skills.

dbAdapter.description: Database adapter to configure for the generated project

dbName.description: Logical database name (used when creating the DB in Postgres/Mongo)
dbName.title: Dbname

dbUri.description: Full database connection string. In normal devcontainer usage this is overridden at runtime from the live .devcontainer/.env (which contains freshly generated credentials). You may leave a placeholder value here.
dbUri.title: Dburi

adminEmail.description: Email address for the initial admin user in the Payload admin panel
adminEmail.title: Adminemail

telemetry.description: Whether to enable Payload's anonymous telemetry
telemetry.title: Telemetry

title: XGIC Create Payload Config
